<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Six pure native harness mappers, shared revision-snapshot storage and explicit SDK/CLI/catalog composition; preserve native evidence and honest fidelity boundaries.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Export Codex, Oh My Pi, Pi, Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot and Cursor using explicit sources and shared ports.
- Run independent mappers concurrently; isolate shared snapshot/SQLite storage from ready JSONL lanes.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No private content capture in fixtures, implicit scans, plugin runtime, daemon or network dependency.
- No automatic main landing, remote publication or workspace retirement; no lossless/final-session claim.
